brief.meaningEn: A performer’s ability to hold viewers’ attention and make an impression on camera, sometimes through quiet expression rather than dramatic movement or fame.
brief.meaningZh: 表演者在鏡頭前吸引觀眾目光、留下鮮明印象的能力；可以靠細微表情，並非一定要誇張演出或有名氣。
brief.grammar: Usually uncountable: have, show or lack screen presence; “a strong/quiet screen presence” evaluates its quality. Use for someone seen on film or video, not simply a person’s physical presence near a screen.
brief.register: Neutral film and video criticism; also natural when discussing a filmed presenter or performer.
brief.boundaryZh: 指觀眾透過鏡頭感受到的吸引力；不等於演員本人有名、外表漂亮、現場健談或影片製作昂貴。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把 screen presence 當作「出現在螢幕上」的事實；需要有吸引觀眾的表現。
brief.outcomeZh: 能根據鏡頭前的實際表現評價吸引力，並與名氣、外貌、拍攝技術及現場魅力分開。

listening.promptEn: Why does the casting director ask to see another camera test of the quiet actor?
listening.promptZh: 選角導演為何要求再看那位寡言演員的試鏡片段？

options.en: Her small reaction made the tense moment compelling on camera.
options.zh: 她細微的反應令鏡頭中的緊張一刻引人入勝。

options.en: She is already the most famous applicant.
options.zh: 她已是最有名的應徵者。

options.en: The lighting made every applicant look equally expressive.
options.zh: 燈光令所有應徵者看起來同樣生動。

options.en: She spoke more loudly than the other actors.
options.zh: 她比其他演員說話更響亮。

listening.explanationZh: 導演注意到她在鏡頭前用細微反應抓住觀眾；名氣、燈光或音量都不是錄音所述原因。
listening.en: The actor barely speaks in the camera test, but her brief glance at the empty chair holds my attention. She has screen presence; I want to watch that moment again before we cast anyone.
listening.zh: 那位演員在試鏡片段中幾乎沒有台詞，但她看向空椅子的短暫一瞥令我移不開目光。她有鏡頭魅力；選角前我想再看一遍。

reply.promptEn: We need a host for a filmed science demonstration. Mei speaks steadily to the lens and keeps viewers engaged, though she is less well known than the other candidate. What should we tell the team?
reply.promptZh: 我們要為科學示範短片選主持。Mei 對着鏡頭說話穩定，能留住觀眾注意力，但她不及另一候選人有名。我們該怎樣向團隊建議？

options.en: Mei has screen presence; I would choose her because her calm delivery keeps viewers watching.
options.zh: Mei 有鏡頭魅力；她沉穩的表達能留住觀眾，我會選她。

options.en: I would choose Mei; the camera test shows that viewers can follow her explanation without losing interest.
options.zh: 我會選 Mei；試鏡顯示觀眾能跟上她的解說，亦不會失去興趣。

options.en: Her steady delivery works on video, so let us ask Mei to host this demonstration.
options.zh: 她在影片中的表達穩定，我們就請 Mei 主持這次示範吧。

options.en: Mei draws attention to the experiment rather than herself, and that makes her a good choice on camera.
options.zh: Mei 能把觀眾目光引向實驗而非自己，適合在鏡頭前主持。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都依據 Mei 的鏡頭表現提出選她的合理建議；金句直接使用 screen presence。

scene.promptEn: A local history video pairs two interview clips. One speaker is a familiar name but reads stiffly; the other is an unknown woman who holds viewers’ attention with a pause before revealing a family photograph. Which assessment fits the second speaker?
scene.promptZh: 一段地方歷史影片比較兩段訪問。一位講者很有名，卻讀得生硬；另一位沒有名氣，但展示家庭照片前的一次停頓抓住了觀眾。哪句最能評價第二位講者？

options.en: The pause gives the unknown speaker screen presence, regardless of fame.
options.zh: 那次停頓令這位沒有名氣的講者在鏡頭前有吸引力，與名氣無關。

options.en: The slower delivery alone proves that the second speaker is the better historian.
options.zh: 第二位講者說得較慢，單憑這一點便證明她是較好的歷史學家。

options.en: The familiar speaker’s name matters more than what viewers actually see in the clip.
options.zh: 熟悉的講者名字比觀眾實際看到的片段更重要。

scene.explanationZh: 第二位講者透過鏡頭前的停頓吸引觀眾；題目沒有說她更有名，也不支持名氣必然帶來吸引力。

contrast.promptEn: Which observation is weakest evidence that a performer has screen presence?
contrast.promptZh: 哪項觀察最不能證明表演者有鏡頭魅力？

options.en: Viewers stay engaged during a silent close-up of her face.
options.zh: 觀眾看她無聲的面部特寫時仍然投入。

options.en: She is charming at a dinner after filming, but the camera test feels flat.
options.zh: 拍攝後她在晚宴上很有魅力，但試鏡片段顯得平淡。

options.en: A small change in her expression makes the scene more tense on video.
options.zh: 她表情的微小變化令影片中的場面更緊張。

contrast.explanationZh: 鏡頭外的社交魅力不能代替鏡頭前的吸引力；另外兩項都直接描述片中效果。

dialogue.promptEn: The producer says, “Our short educational film needs someone the audience will keep watching, but we cannot afford a celebrity.” The audition shows that Arun makes a plain safety explanation engaging. What reply best addresses the producer’s need?
dialogue.promptZh: 製作人說：「教育短片需要觀眾願意一直看下去的講者，但我們請不起名人。」試鏡顯示 Arun 能把平實的安全講解說得吸引。哪句最能回應製作人的需要？

options.en: Arun shows screen presence in the audition; we can choose Arun without hiring a celebrity.
options.zh: Arun 在試鏡中展現鏡頭魅力；我們毋須請名人也可選 Arun。

options.en: The celebrity may attract initial clicks, so choose that applicant despite the flat camera test.
options.zh: 名人或可吸引觀眾點開影片，所以即使試鏡表現平淡，也該選那位應徵者。

options.en: Let us spend the host budget on more graphics; Arun’s engaging camera test is less relevant than visual polish.
options.zh: 不如把主持預算用在更多動畫上；Arun 吸引人的試鏡表現不及畫面精美重要。

dialogue.explanationZh: Arun 的試鏡已顯示他能在鏡頭前留住觀眾；另外兩句忽略影片效果或現有試鏡證據。

speaking.en: The dancer has screen presence because her stillness makes the final shot memorable.
speaking.zh: 那位舞者有鏡頭魅力，因為她靜止不動的一刻令最後的鏡頭令人難忘。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出片中一項具體表現如何吸引觀眾。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區單車安全短片要選一位示範員。一位男義工名氣較小，但試鏡中能用眼神和沉穩語氣留住觀眾，清楚帶出戴頭盔的步驟。請用一至兩句英文向導演建議是否選他，並以鏡頭前的證據說明。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩例都提出選人建議，指出試鏡中具體的鏡頭表現與頭盔示範效果；不能只說他有名、好看或現場健談。

examples.en: I would cast the lesser-known volunteer: his steady look into the lens gives him screen presence, and viewers stay focused as he fastens the helmet strap.
examples.zh: 我會選那位名氣較小的義工：他穩定地望向鏡頭，展現鏡頭魅力，觀眾也會專注看他扣好頭盔帶。

examples.en: The volunteer has screen presence in the camera test. His quiet pause before checking the helmet fit draws attention to that safety step, so I would choose him for the video.
examples.zh: 那位義工在試鏡中有鏡頭魅力。他檢查頭盔是否合身前稍作停頓，令觀眾注意這個安全步驟，因此我會選他拍短片。

glossary.en: his steady look into the lens

takeaways.en: Screen presence is the ability to hold attention on camera, even through a quiet performance.
takeaways.zh: 鏡頭魅力是在鏡頭前留住觀眾注意力的能力，細膩的表演也可以做到。

takeaways.en: A newcomer can have screen presence without a famous name or expensive production.
takeaways.zh: 新人即使沒有名氣或昂貴製作，也可以有鏡頭魅力。

brief.meaningEn: A figurative collection of service parts, rules or arrangements that have been pieced together without enough coordination, leaving gaps or inconsistent experiences. “Less like a patchwork” means those parts now work together more coherently.
brief.meaningZh: 把服務、規則或安排比作缺乏協調的拼布：各部分湊在一起，卻留下缺口或造成不一致。「較不像零碎拼湊」表示它們如今更連貫。
brief.grammar: A patchwork of + plural services/rules/arrangements; a patchwork system is also possible. “Less like a patchwork” compares a better-integrated later state with an earlier fragmented one. A literal patchwork quilt is not this figurative service sense.
brief.register: Neutral to mildly critical in discussions of public services, administration or systems; use evidence of gaps or incompatible parts.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是各部分缺乏銜接，並非「有不同服務」本身不好；若多種服務能順暢配合，不應只因種類多便稱為 patchwork。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要把拼布的字面意思套在服務上；亦不要把服務變得連貫誤解為所有服務都被取消。
brief.outcomeZh: 能根據缺口、互相矛盾的規則及改善後的銜接，判斷 patchwork 何時適用。

listening.promptEn: Why does the caller describe the clinic booking system as a patchwork?
listening.promptZh: 來電者為何說診所預約系統像零碎拼湊而成？

options.en: Branches use conflicting forms and do not share a booking record.
options.zh: 各分所使用互相矛盾的表格，也不共用預約紀錄。

options.en: The clinics offer several services through one clear booking route.
options.zh: 診所透過一條清晰的預約途徑提供多種服務。

options.en: The caller dislikes the pattern on a waiting-room blanket.
options.zh: 來電者不喜歡候診室毛毯上的圖案。

options.en: Every branch has agreed on the same form and appointment rules.
options.zh: 所有分所都採用相同表格及預約規則。

listening.explanationZh: 表格規則互相矛盾，預約紀錄又不能共用，才會令系統零碎；多樣化本身不是問題。
listening.en: I filled in one form for the north clinic, then the south clinic told me to start again and could not see my booking. The system feels like a patchwork of rules, not one service.
listening.zh: 我為北區診所填了一份表，南區診所卻叫我從頭再填，還看不到我的預約。這套系統的規則像零碎拼湊，並不像一項連貫服務。

reply.promptEn: Parents use four after-school clubs, but each club sends a different timetable and change notice. Several families have missed sessions. What could we suggest to the coordinator?
reply.promptZh: 家長會用四個課後小組的服務，但每組發放不同時間表及改動通知，已有幾個家庭錯過活動。我們可向統籌員建議甚麼？

options.en: The notices feel like a patchwork of schedules; let us publish one shared calendar with a named contact for changes.
options.zh: 通知像零碎拼湊的時間表；我們可發佈一份共用日曆，並列出改動聯絡人。

options.en: Let us put all four timetables in one calendar and update families whenever a session moves.
options.zh: 我們把四份時間表放進同一日曆，每次活動改期便通知家庭。

options.en: A single change log would help parents see what moved without checking four separate messages.
options.zh: 一份共用改動紀錄可讓家長看清哪些活動改期，不用翻查四則不同訊息。

options.en: Could each club send its updates to one coordinator, who then posts a consistent notice to families?
options.zh: 可否由各小組先把改動交給同一位統籌員，再由他向家長發出一致通知？

reply.explanationZh: 四句都提出讓四組資訊銜接的可行辦法；金句直接指出目前時間表零碎拼湊。

scene.promptEn: During a flood, three aid groups advertise different opening hours and eligibility rules. A family is sent from one desk to another because no group knows which supplies remain. Which description fits?
scene.promptZh: 水災期間，三個援助團體公佈不同的開放時間及申請資格。一家人被轉介到不同櫃位，因為各團體都不知道還有哪些物資。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The aid is a patchwork of services with gaps between the groups.
options.zh: 援助服務零碎拼湊，團體之間出現銜接缺口。

options.en: Different opening hours simply show that the groups are matching every family to the right aid.
options.zh: 開放時間不同，只表示各團體正把每個家庭配對到合適援助。

options.en: The family can solve the problem by checking each desk separately; no shared stock record is needed.
options.zh: 那家人只要逐一詢問櫃位便能解決問題，毋須共用物資紀錄。

scene.explanationZh: 時間、資格與物資資料都欠缺協調，令家庭在不同團體之間遇到缺口；其他兩項與題目相反。

contrast.promptEn: Which situation is least fairly described as a figurative patchwork?
contrast.promptZh: 哪種情況最不宜用比喻的 patchwork 形容？

options.en: A council lists several support schemes, but each has a separate form and contradictory deadlines.
options.zh: 議會列出多種支援計劃，但每種表格不同，截止日期亦互相矛盾。

options.en: Different specialists work through one referral form and keep each other informed.
options.zh: 不同專家共用一份轉介表，並互通最新情況。

options.en: Three agencies publish different rules for the same parking permit.
options.zh: 三個機構為同一停車許可證公佈不同規則。

contrast.explanationZh: 專業人員雖然不同，卻能透過共用表格及溝通協作；多樣化不等於零碎拼湊。

dialogue.promptEn: A resident says, “On this street the recycling bin is collected on Tuesday, but the next street uses a different form and collection day. Nobody explains the boundary.” What reply identifies the problem accurately?
dialogue.promptZh: 居民說：「這條街星期二收回收桶，隔鄰街道卻要填另一份表，而且收集日不同；沒有人解釋分界。」哪句能準確指出問題？

options.en: The rules are a patchwork of arrangements; residents need one clear map and notice.
options.zh: 規則像零碎拼湊的安排；居民需要一張清晰地圖及通知。

options.en: Since both streets recycle, residents can use one notice without checking the conflicting forms.
options.zh: 既然兩條街都有回收，居民毋須核對不同表格，也可只看一份通知。

options.en: Residents could follow the next street’s collection day until someone explains the boundary.
options.zh: 在有人解釋分界前，居民可暫時按隔鄰街道的收集日處理。

dialogue.explanationZh: 同樣是回收，兩街卻有不同表格及日子而未解釋分界；金句指出安排不連貫並提出清晰資訊。

speaking.en: The permit rules feel like a patchwork because each office asks for a different document.
speaking.zh: 許可證規則像零碎拼湊，因為每個辦事處都要求不同文件。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出一項具體的不一致之處，而不只說服務種類多。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一所大學的無障礙支援原先由幾個辦公室分別處理，學生每到一處都要重新交資料。校方改用單一申請入口，讓相關辦公室共用更新。請用一至兩句英文向學生會說明之前為何像零碎拼湊，以及現在改善了甚麼。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩例都指出之前要重交資料或通知不一致，並說明單一入口和共用更新如何改善銜接；不能只說服務種類多，也不能聲稱所有辦公室已取消。

examples.en: Support used to feel like a patchwork of services because students repeated the same details at several offices. The shared intake now passes updates to each team without another application.
examples.zh: 支援服務以前像零碎拼湊，因為學生要在幾個辦公室重複提交同一資料。現在共用申請入口把更新傳給各團隊，毋須重新申請。

examples.en: The old arrangement was a patchwork of forms, and students sometimes received conflicting instructions. One entry point and shared updates now make the offices work together more smoothly.
examples.zh: 舊安排的表格零碎拼湊，學生有時收到互相矛盾的指示。現在單一入口配合共用更新，令各辦公室的工作更順暢地銜接。

takeaways.en: A patchwork of services causes trouble when its parts leave gaps or give conflicting instructions.
takeaways.zh: 若各部分留下缺口或提供矛盾指示，零碎拼湊的服務就會造成困擾。

takeaways.en: A shared intake can make several offices feel less like a patchwork without removing their different roles.
takeaways.zh: 共用申請入口可讓多個辦公室的服務更連貫，而毋須取消各自的職能。
